mapper.sql: select p.ground_id, p.batch_id, p.trial_id, p.trial_field_name, p.research_center_id, p.program_id, p.sub_program_id, p.research_field_id, p.region, p.zone, p.woreda, p.kebele, p.agricultural_eco_zone, p.gps_location, p.start_date, p.season, p.activity_code, p.kpi_code, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.create_by, p.update_by, p.is_deleted, b.crop_type, b.variety_name, b.batch_name, (select count(1) from sowing_info s where s.ground_id = p.ground_id and s.is_deleted = 0) as sowing_count from plot_info p left join breeding_batch b on p.batch_id = b.batch_id and b.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: select p.ground_id, p.batch_id, p.trial_id, p.trial_field_name, p.research_center_id, p.program_id, p.sub_program_id, p.research_field_id, p.region, p.zone, p.woreda, p.kebele, p.agricultural_eco_zone, p.gps_location, p.start_date, p.season, p.activity_code, p.kpi_code, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.create_by, p.update_by, p.is_deleted, b.crop_type, b.variety_name, b.batch_name, s.sowing_id, s.ground_id as sowing_ground_id, s.seed_quantity, s.sowing_method, s.sowing_time, s.create_time as sowing_create_time from plot_info p left join breeding_batch b on p.batch_id = b.batch_id and b.is_deleted = 0 left join sowing_info s on p.ground_id = s.ground_id and s.is_deleted = 0 where p.ground_id = #{groundId} and p.is_deleted = 0

select p.ground_id, p.trial_field_name, p.gps_location from plot_info p inner join trial_plot_relation r on p.ground_id = r.ground_id and r.is_deleted = 0 where r.trial_id = #{trialId} and p.is_deleted = 0
select ground_id, batch_id, trial_field_name, gps_location, start_date from plot_info where batch_id = #{batchId} and is_deleted = 0 order by create_time desc
